title: Conditional κ = .0038982016137 (+0.0000413960289364322% over #8055; +0.0007333743220988280% over #8054): round unequal Gaussian packets
body:
## Result

**Conditional κ = 0.0038982016137.** The latest independently reproduced external peer is [#8055](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/8055) at `7b48187d99525ad59f560de3921ec7e48382484c`, κ = 0.0038982. The exact gain is `16137/10000000000000` = 0.0000000016137, exactly `(5379/129940000)%` (approximately **+0.0000413960289364322%**). Over the signed predecessor [#8054](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/8054) at `f6f4ecd5dd717ce2b155dd564469e9693ac90f6d`, κ = 0.0038981730255, the exact increase is `142941/5000000000000` = 0.0000000285882, or exactly `(65720/89613173)%` (approximately +0.0007333743220988280%). #8055 has a smaller activated carrier and setup. The numerical comparison uses each witness's complete installed conditional bound. The maintainer-selected record remains #7000.

## Construction

Use ordered lengths `w // 4` and `w - w // 4` on the original 1,006 split base-copy returns of the 1-to-8 Gaussian word. The adjacent-axis partitions use the same owner and chart return, with no extra paid position. At the production width 32,762, the old fractional proposal has no legal axis count. The rounded version emits sizes 8,190 and 24,572. The same integer formula also drives the decoder contract and leaf ledger. The paid upper stock contains 564,142 requests and the productive stock contains 105,216 targets.

The new numerical trial is `4286126377/2^40`. Its 55 transport cells fund both production residues. The all-size prefix fit, residual fringe, bounded-grid integration, chronology, and independent integer invoice retain the 39/256 finite-height debit. Both binary stages are inherited at 60,000 and 960,000, the numerical height is 20,000,000, and the stop denominator is 10^18. The prior half-split word fails the new raw-price control. The rounded ledger rejects an overstated paid axis count.
